main_body: Flat-roofed sandstone building: a sand-coloured roof deck with a teal dome on top, over a brick front wall with an arched door and a lattice window
top_band: Sand roof deck, L 190-214 (#f2d3a0 / #e3b77e), rows 3-33 at x=16 and x=32. Light front-edge rows 30-33, then an abrupt drop to the dark #6e4430 rows 34-36.
evidence: The column at x=16 reads as a light roof surface (rows 3-33, with a lit front-edge line at rows 30-33), then a dark eave shadow at rows 34-36, then a brick front face (L~108-137) from row 37 down. The step between roof and wall is far above 25 L. The roof is a large horizontal deck seen from above, and the dome sits on it. The front wall has its own brick courses, an inset door with a dark inner top and a window with a sill. No receding side face. It is a valid 3/4 building with a flat roof. The roof is tall, but the front face is clearly drawn, so this is not a top-down plan.

style.evidence: The outlines are tinted dark brown (0% neutral dark edge pixels), set selectively next to the sand and brick. Sand and brick each carry about 5 tones, and the dome has 4 teal steps. The roof has speckle and the wall has per-brick tone variation, so flat-fill coverage is only 2%. Density is lower than the references: 8 colours per tile against 11 and 18, and 30 distinct colours against 66 and 185. The palette is locked and the piece is simple, and it is not a sticker look, so it is acceptable next to the stone-house reference.
